Class Gym

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.structure.Gym
public final class Gym extends Object
The sports venue VarZinho is installed in: its courts, and through them every camera it owns.

The gym is where rules that span courts live. Court numbers are unique within it, and so are camera ids, because the archive tells cameras apart by id alone. It keeps no highlights; the archive does.

    • installCamera

      public void installCamera(int courtNumber, Camera camera)
      Mounts a camera on one of the gym's courts. Ids are unique across the whole gym, not only within a court: clips are named after their camera, and the archive tells cameras apart by id alone.
      Parameters:
      courtNumber - the court to mount the camera on
      camera - the camera to mount
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the gym has no court with that number, or the camera is null
      DuplicateCameraException - if any court already holds a camera with that id

    • moveCamera

      public void moveCamera(Camera camera, int toCourt)
      Takes a camera off its court and mounts it on another. A camera is equipment, not part of the court, so it can change courts and keep its id.

      A camera that was recording arrives switched off. Switching it on in its new court starts an empty buffer, so no highlight there holds the old court's footage. A camera under maintenance stays under maintenance.

      Parameters:
      camera - the camera to move, already installed somewhere in this gym
      toCourt - the number of the court it moves to
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the gym does not hold the camera, has no court with that number, or the camera is already on it; nothing moves

    • removeCourt

      public void removeCourt(int number)
      Takes an empty court out of the gym. Cameras are equipment that outlives the court, so a court still holding one is refused rather than emptied: the operator removes or moves them first. Highlights already captured there are untouched.
      Parameters:
      number - the number of the court to remove
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the gym has no court with that number
      IllegalStateException - if the court still holds a camera; nothing changes
